definitions.gloss: to be relieved; to feel reassured
definitions.explanation: To experience a feeling of relief after worry or anxiety has been resolved. Commonly used to describe the emotional release when a feared outcome does not occur.

examples.japanese: ⟦{無事|ぶじ}→無事：01602_buji⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧{安堵|あんど}した。
examples.english: I was relieved to hear that everyone was safe.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}して→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧、⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧⟦{安堵|あんど}→安堵：05818_ando⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せた→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: Having passed the exam, she finally showed a look of relief.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}した→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{知|し}らせ→知らせ：03252_shirase⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{安堵|あんど}した。
examples.english: The whole family was relieved at the news that the surgery was successful.

notes:
USAGE:
{安堵|あんど}する is somewhat formal and literary compared to ⟦ほっとする→ほっとする：07652_hottosuru⟧, which is the more colloquial equivalent. ⟦{安堵|あんど}→安堵：05818_ando⟧ is frequently used as a noun modifier, as in ⟦{安堵|あんど}→安堵：05818_ando⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧ (expression of relief) or ⟦{安堵|あんど}{感|かん}→安堵感：19956_andokan⟧ (sense of relief).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{安堵|あんど}→安堵：05818_ando⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧ (expression of relief)
- ⟦{安堵|あんど}{感|かん}→安堵感：19956_andokan⟧ (sense of relief)
- ⟦{安堵|あんど}→安堵：05818_ando⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{溜|た}め{息|いき} (sigh of relief)
- ⟦{安堵|あんど}→安堵：05818_ando⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浮|う}かべる→浮かべる：13314_ukaberu⟧ (to show signs of relief)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ほっとする→ほっとする：07652_hottosuru⟧: to feel relieved (casual, everyday)
- ⟦{安心|あんしん}する→安心する：06067_anshinsuru⟧: to feel at ease, to be reassured
